entries.53c3f229be1dee6c: It is advancing the medium-term management plan "FV26" with the fiscal year ending December 2026 as its final year. It aims for growth exceeding the market growth rate and has a policy of actively making capital investment and research and development investment. In the probe card business, for memory probe cards it will maintain its share through strengthening production capacity and developing new technology, and for non-memory it aims to expand its share by launching new MEMS-type products. In the TE business, it aims to secure a stable earnings source through growth of the contactor business, growth through new products for semiconductor testing, and turning field support into a revenue source. Because the plan's target figures concern future matters, they are not reproduced here.

entries.b2c4e5e27f69e27c: A business that develops, manufactures and sells probe cards, which are semiconductor measurement tools. In the wafer inspection process of semiconductor manufacturing, probe cards play a role similar to a connector: pins make contact with the electrodes of semiconductor chips on a silicon wafer, linking the tester and the chips. In addition to the company, Kunshan Maikexin Microelectronics Co., Ltd. in China and MEK Co.,Ltd. in Korea manufacture and sell products, and subsidiaries in the United States, Germany, Taiwan and Singapore handle sales and maintenance. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥68,525 million.
